research_gaps: Trade‑off between fine‑grained detail preservation (adaptive binning + attention) and real‑time latency for high‑resolution inputs.
Lack of a unified evaluation framework that jointly measures metric accuracy, relative ordering, and cross‑domain robustness, making fair comparison of zero‑shot vs fine‑tuned models difficult.
Degradation of geometric fidelity on out‑of‑distribution or extremely high‑resolution scenes despite large semi‑supervised pre‑training.

proposals.name: Sparse‑Attention Adaptive Binning Transformer (SA‑ABT)
proposals.rationale: Combine a lightweight hierarchical transformer with sparse‑global attention (e.g., LongFormer or Performer) to keep per‑pixel cost low, and embed Adaptive Binning as a differentiable token‑wise quantiser. Multi‑scale feature maps are fused via edge‑aware attention modules that focus computation on high‑gradient regions.
proposals.expected_benefit: Achieves sub‑30 ms inference on 1080p while retaining the fine‑grained depth discretisation of BinsFormer, reducing blur on thin structures.
proposals.risk: Sparse attention patterns may miss subtle texture cues in low‑contrast areas, requiring careful tuning of sparsity schedules.

proposals.name: Unified Metric‑Relative Benchmark Suite (UMR‑Bench)
proposals.rationale: Design a comprehensive benchmark that includes (a) metric depth tests on calibrated LiDAR datasets, (b) relative depth ranking on crowd‑sourced datasets, and (c) cross‑domain zero‑shot splits using synthetic‑real mixtures. Provide standardized protocols for latency, memory, and FLOPs reporting.
proposals.expected_benefit: Enables reproducible, apples‑to‑apples comparison of methods that output metric vs relative depths, drives community convergence on evaluation best‑practices, and highlights true generalisation gaps.
proposals.risk: Collecting high‑quality metric ground truth for diverse domains is costly; the suite may initially rely on imperfect proxy labels.

proposals.name: Hybrid Real‑Synthetic Curriculum Training (HRSC‑Curriculum)
proposals.rationale: Introduce a curriculum that gradually increases scene complexity and resolution, mixing synthetic data (perfect metric depth) with real semi‑supervised samples. The model learns to align metric scales early on and later adapts to domain variations, using a consistency loss across resolutions.
proposals.expected_benefit: Improves geometric fidelity on ultra‑high‑resolution and OOD images without sacrificing zero‑shot performance, leveraging the existing 62 M Depth Anything corpus more effectively.
proposals.risk: Curriculum design adds training overhead and hyper‑parameter complexity; improper scheduling may lead to over‑fitting to synthetic patterns.
